msContents.summary: The primary e-codices catalogue, reproducing Scherrer (1875), identifies the end of the Amores at III.7.74 and explicitly states that the final ten verses of that poem and the remaining eight elegies of Book III are absent. Actual page 396 ends at 3.7.74. All following numbered pages 397–406 and the rear pastedown were inspected: 397–404 are blank apart from pagination and incidental marks, 405 is a separate Metamorphoses fragment, and 406 and the binding material provide no identified Amores continuation. Absence is not inferred from missing annotations. Its historical physical cause is not asserted.

listBibl.bibl: Gustav Scherrer, Verzeichniss der Handschriften der Stiftsbibliothek von St. Gallen (Halle, 1875), pp. 297–298. Primary library catalogue in TEI

projectDesc.p: Amores 3.10, canonical positions 1–48, is recorded as wholly absent from this witness. The canonical extent is an editorial alignment inventory, not a claim about the number of physical lines once present. No verse text or hypothetical source rectangle is supplied.

segmentation.p: A single gap with reason not-transmitted and unit line records the full canonical extent. The supporting facsimile surfaces document the manuscript endpoint and subsequent leaves; they are not locations of the absent verses. There are no l elements or invented verse facs pointers.

interpretation.p: Two different agents inspected the primary catalogue and actual remaining source surfaces. No historical physical cause is assigned. Supporting surfaces are evidence of absence, not locations of hypothetical verses.
